ShareRemark

ShareTypeFlag
Share resource type. TEMPORARY (0x40000000)  is a temporary share while SPECIAL (0x80000000) is an Interprocess
communication (IPC$) or remote administration of the server (ADMIN$). SPECIAL (0x80000000) can also refer to administrative
shares such as C$, D$, E$, and so forth. For more information, see Network Share Functions.
Values:
TEMPORARY (0x40000000)
SPECIAL (0x80000000)
